Mina / Sarah / Laura — technical follow-up from infra side. Short notes on the subprocessor list:

- We reviewed CloudWave_Subprocessor_List.xlsx. Most entries have SOC 2 references but only two have encryption-at-rest key-handling details documented. We need either: (a) KMS separation (CloudWave-managed keys) with a documented key-access policy; or (b) customer-managed keys for sensitive workloads (Preferred for Dedicated deployments).
- If CloudWave plans to onboard the analytics partner that requires model cache access, we will require a scoped Subprocessor Agreement and attestation (signed) before we enable token-level integration.
- For data residency: Redwood's Dedicated customers sometimes require US-only storage. If CloudWave wants to support US-only for the analytics partner, we need a clause in the Order Form and an appendix to the DPA.

Attached: dpa-checklist.xlsx (we use this to map which DPA variant is needed).

If CloudWave accepts notice + 72-hour objection window for non-sensitive subprocessors and named consent for those with key access, that will work operationally.

Dev Patel

Subject: Re: Initial vendor tiering packet + MSA redlines for Redwood

Sarah — thanks for the packet and for the patience while we reviewed. Summary and next steps from Redwood legal/procurement: 

Summary of material positions we will send as a short redline counter:
- Subcontracting: Redwood can accept a notice + objection flow for standard vendors; any vendor that would obtain KMS access, model KV cache access, or persistent plaintext data must be listed as a named subprocessor and require prior written consent.
- DPA: we need an appendix addressing regional isolation for Dedicated customers (US-only option) and explicit key-handling descriptions. We will provide a DPA appendix template.
- SLA / Order Form: If the analytics partner is part of the core delivery for the Order Form, we will require a Service Annex to be attached to the Order Form identifying the partner and specific SLAs.

Requested artifacts (please provide by Friday 03/12):
1) Signed SOC 2 Type II report for the analytics partner (redacted acceptable);
2) KMS/key-handling attestation for any subprocessor with key access;
3) Confirmation of whether CloudWave needs named consent for analytics partner or will accept our named-consent requirement.

Procurement action: I will generate a short redlines_summary.md and a draft DPA appendix. Mina — I'll need a go/no-go on whether to route this as Hosted vs Dedicated order form; that determines the appendix language.

Once we have the artifacts we'll route to procurement for PO setup and to contracts for final sign-off. If you prefer, we can run a quick 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk the checklist.

Regards,

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Procurement
